response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software developer with strong credentials in TypeScript, Node.js, and some low-latency systems work in DLang, but the resume shows no evidence of SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, GPU or SIMD/MIMD experience, or deep-learning workload performance optimization — the core requirements of this principal-level hardware performance architect role. While tenure exceeds the years-of-experience bar, the domain mismatch is fundamental.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience, exceeding the experience threshold
Some high-performance systems work (low-latency async I/O services handling millions of requests/sec in DLang)
Strong software craftsmanship: testing, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and teaching/mentoring
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, hardware design, or hardware-software co-design experience
No GPU architecture, SIMD/MIMD, or AI accelerator background; AI exposure limited to agent tooling, not workload/performance optimization
Career trajectory is web/full-stack product engineering, far from principal-level performance architecture

key_factors.factor: No deep-learning workload performance or GPU expertise
Long software engineering tenure with some low-latency systems work
